source: Copernicus Sentinel-2 Level-2A / Microsoft Planetary Computer
method: Up to one scene per year and sector, January–April except 2015 June–December; lowest scene-level cloud cover below 15% among catalogue results. This is a visual selection, not an annual mosaic, local cloud validation, a tidally corrected shoreline, or an erosion measurement.
limitations: 10 m true-colour pixels. Cloud percentage describes the whole scene; no tide datum is attached. Original multispectral rasters have not been downloaded. Each accepted entry has a received, decoded nontransparent PNG sample and a STAC metadata snapshot.
